Glance 2026.09.30 improves text and Markdown previews.

- Choose the default Markdown and JSON views, and customize the Markdown font, font size and rendering theme.
- Select more common international text encodings from a scrollable menu, with UTF encodings and system ANSI at the top.
- Automatically preview decodable unknown files as text using a bounded content sample.
- Show file format identification progress and increase identification budgets, with startup time accounted for separately.
- Synchronize text and Markdown preview visibility to prevent stale content and startup flicker.
